name: spatial_dense_reach_level2_50d
description: A robotics benchmark measuring agents' ability to densely reach specified spatial targets in environments with contact interactions and high-dimensional state spaces (50 dimensions). It evaluates control and planning systems on accurate, contact-aware reaching behavior across many target configurations. The suite is used to assess robustness and generalization of motion planners and controllers under contact constraints.
reputation: A specialized benchmark in contact-aware robotics research with niche adoption among simulation and control communities.
